# PiHoleBar
> macOS menu bar app that shows Pi-hole v6 status, stats and lets you pause blocking.

- [README](https://github.com/Griff2325/pihole-menubar/blob/main/README.md): install (brew cask or zip), usage, screenshots
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Griff2325/pihole-menubar/blob/main/AGENTS.md): build, code map, conventions
